purpose: Continue the Atlas after the original P00–P17 implementation roadmap with a governed programme to resolve every public data slot without inventing values or weakening source standards.
relationship_to_v1_release: This roadmap is intentionally separate from data/project-roadmap.json. P00–P17 remain the v1.0 implementation/release ledger; P18–P26 govern the subsequent data-completion programme and must not alter P17 release-count semantics.
completion_definition: Every one of the 20,115 governed public slot instances is resolved by a published/direct observation, a transparently derived/modelled value permitted by policy, a verified external observation, or an explicit governed closure state such as not applicable, source not published, boundary unresolved, or retired/replaced. Unknown blanks must equal zero.
rules: Do not manufacture a value merely to raise completion.
Do not inherit a parent-geography value into a child geography unless the indicator policy explicitly permits a derived cross-level measure.
Promote existing canonical observations before acquiring new data.
Use primary official sources where practical and retain source, period, unit, denominator and uncertainty metadata.
Survey estimates must retain required uncertainty or sample metadata before activation.
When a proposed slot has no defensible comparable source, replace, retire or explicitly close it rather than scrape weak substitutes.
Generated registries and completeness outputs must be reproducible from source snapshots and build scripts.
A phase is complete only when its governed queue is zero or every remaining row has an explicit approved closure state, and the full Atlas validation/P16 gates remain green where the website changes.
